AGM TaipanV2 15-256 Thermal Imaging Monocular

A step up in reach — same sensor, more detection range.

around $595

The middle TaipanV2: same 256x192 sensor as the 10-256 with a longer lens for more detection range. If the entry model is 'does thermal work for skywatching?', this one is 'let me actually track what I find'. The $100 step up buys you noticeably more time on target.

  • Won't see through clouds or glass
